import networkx as nx
from itertools import combinations

def check_graph(G):
    if len(G) != 12: return False
    # check alpha <= 3
    # which means no independent set of size 4
    # independent set in G is clique in complement
    G_comp = nx.complement(G)
    from networkx.algorithms.clique import graph_clique_number
    if graph_clique_number(G_comp) > 3:
        return False
    # check connectivity >= 4
    if nx.node_connectivity(G) < 4:
        return False
    return True

# Try Paley 13 minus one vertex
G = nx.Graph()
G.add_nodes_from(range(13))
for i in range(13):
    for j in range(i+1, 13):
        if (j - i) % 13 in [1, 3, 4, 9, 10, 12]:
            G.add_edge(i, j)

G.remove_node(12)
G = nx.convert_node_labels_to_integers(G)
print("Paley 13 minus 1:", check_graph(G))
if check_graph(G):
    print(list(G.edges()))
